claims.text: Thrashing Dragons are hungry, passionate vampires drawn to battle, scandal and bearing children, which many Resplendent Cranes and Devil-Tigers find distasteful.
The Dharma is not hunted as a cult, but its members often stand at a disadvantage in the courts.
The Dharma does little capturing and training of chih-mei, leaving Devil-Tigers and Thousand Whispers to teach new vampires survival before the Dragons take over their schooling.

title: Black Earth Boy
summary: A bodhisattva of the Thrashing Dragons.

claims.text: Black Earth Boy, mighty and full of childlike joy and a terrible foe of darkness, rose to the Hundred Clouds at the turn of the Fourth Age, during the Mongol conquest of the Southern Song.

title: Shout of Anger
summary: The voice of the Dragons in the Golden Courts.

claims.text: The Golden Courts' Dragons have had no bodhisattvas, but a penanggalan called Shout of Anger is said to be close to that state and speaks for the faith when the Golden Courts must make their view known.

title: Dragons Among the Spirits
summary: Thrashing Dragons who walk the Yang courts.

claims.text: Some Dragons walk the Yang courts, leading spirit servants on red silk leashes and dining with the lesser princes of the Yang World; for all their manners, they treat shen as props and scenery on the road to enlightenment.
